patterns.note: The homepage features a dynamic split-screen layout where large, full-bleed project images occupy the main viewport, flanked by narrow vertical strips of project thumbnails on the left and right edges that act as a visual index.

A strong contrast is established between a clean, modern sans-serif for navigation and body text, and an extremely bold, oversized sans-serif used for the brand name as a prominent visual anchor at the bottom of the homepage.

The primary palette is stark black and white, with vibrant blues and purples appearing within the project photography and occasionally as subtle accent colors, creating a sophisticated yet impactful visual experience.

As the user scrolls, the main header sticks to the top, while the large hero images transition and parallax. Simultaneously, the vertical strips of project thumbnails on the page edges scroll independently, revealing more projects and updating their active labels.
The homepage is structured as a continuous visual gallery, with the brand name serving as a large, bold, and distinct footer element that is revealed upon reaching the end of the scroll.

technique_notes: To rebuild the motion system, implement a sticky header that remains at the top of the viewport. The main content area should scroll vertically, but within it, use JavaScript to create a parallax effect for the large hero images, making them scroll at a different rate than the main page. Additionally, implement independent scrolling for the narrow vertical galleries on the left and right edges, allowing them to reveal new thumbnails and update associated text labels as the user scrolls the main page, effectively acting as a scroll-driven navigation.

The site utilizes full-bleed imagery extensively, often presenting two large images side-by-side in a split-screen format for the hero and subsequent project showcases. Content sections on interior pages use a clean, single-column layout with generous vertical spacing, interspersed with full-width images.

Typography is managed by using a clean, legible sans-serif for all functional text (navigation, body, captions) and a distinct, heavy-weight sans-serif at a very large scale for the brand identity, creating a strong visual statement.

design_tokens.type_scale: A clean, modern sans-serif is used for body and navigation, while the brand name employs an extremely oversized, bold sans-serif for a strong visual impact.
design_tokens.spacing: airy, with generous vertical spacing between content blocks and a balanced feel within image grids.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its highly interactive and visually driven homepage, which transforms scrolling into an exploratory experience. The combination of parallaxing hero images, independently scrolling side galleries, and the dramatic reveal of the oversized brand name creates a dynamic and memorable introduction to their work, moving beyond a typical static portfolio.
